disclaimer.short: Automated analysis — the decision is yours.
disclaimer.long: Scores, recommendation and summary are produced automatically from the interview transcript. They are a reading aid, not a decision. Check the quotes behind each claim, and decide yourself.

answers.question: Question {{index}}
answers.uploadFailed: The candidate recorded an answer, but it never reached us. This is a technical failure on our side, not a skipped question.

note.placeholder: What you thought, what to ask next time…
note.hint: Only your team sees this. The candidate never does.

pending.title: The analysis is still running
pending.body: The interview has arrived and is being transcribed and analysed. This usually takes a few minutes.
pending.failedBody: The recordings are safe. Failed steps are retried automatically; if the analysis still has not finished, relaunch it. The last steps are listed below.

notStarted.title: Not started yet
notStarted.body: {{name}} has been invited but has not recorded anything yet.

expired.title: Interview window closed
expired.body: The role's deadline passed before {{name}} finished. To send them a new link, move the deadline back and invite them again.

inProgress.title: In progress
inProgress.body: {{name}} is part-way through — {{answered}} of {{total}} answers recorded.

mediaPurged.title: Recordings deleted
mediaPurged.body: The recordings were deleted on {{date}} under the retention policy. The analysis and transcript remain.

share.title: Share this report
share.subtitle: Creates a link that shows this report only — no other candidate, no access to your account.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke this link?
revokeConfirm.body: Created on {{date}}. {{views}}. Whoever has this link will no longer be able to read the report. This cannot be undone.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Ask whoever shared it with you for a new one.

revoked.title: This link was revoked
revoked.body: It no longer gives access to the report.

notFound.title: This link doesn't work
notFound.body: It may have been mistyped, or revoked.

errors.not_found: This report could not be found.
errors.report_in_progress: The analysis is already running. Give it a few minutes.
errors.session_not_completed: The interview is not finished yet.
errors.rate_limited: You have relaunched a lot of analyses recently. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.insufficient_role: Only admins, owners and the role’s creator can do this.

media.failedTitle: The recordings could not be loaded
media.failedBody: The playback link may have expired, or the connection dropped. The recordings themselves are safe.
